title: Sensitivity corrections for VRP and 01 on Slavich

posts.topic_title: Sensitivity corrections for VRP and 01 on Slavich
posts.author: JohnFP
posts.post_subject: Sensitivity corrections for VRP and 01 on Slavich
posts.content_md:
I e-mailed the Slavich site, pointed out the sensitivity numbers they had for VRP-M and PFG-01 and asked them if they were correct or should they have read uJ (Micro Joules) instead of mJ (milliJoules). Dr. Stanislovas Zacharovas replied and stated they should read microJoules and the mistake has been fixed. Just an FYI.

[http://www.slavich.com/technical.htm](http://www.slavich.com/technical.htm)
